market_summary: Overall Sentiment: Constructive, not alarming. "Right now this is in some ways you could say it's a shakeout" (Ed). The key level to watch is the low of Tuesday's session; an undercut of that level would be more worrisome. Otherwise, the pause is healthy, allowing stocks to form handles and bases.

GEO.technical_action: Attempted breakout on strong volume, RS blue dot. Very tight action, seven-weeks-tight pattern. Support at 10-week/50-day.
GEO.story: Private prison/immigration detention. Government contracts, strong growth. Non-tech diversification.

TSM.technical_action: Stuck under a flat 50-day line; second test of that resistance. ATR is relatively manageable.
TSM.story: AI chip manufacturing giant. A decisive move above the 50-day could be a buy; failure could set up a short. RS line has faded.

NVT.technical_action: Above the 50-day line, right at short-term highs. Pulled back slightly from intraday high. RS line has fallen but growth is strong.
NVT.story: Electrical power/AI data center play. Similar to TSM but slightly stronger; could be actionable on a break higher.

LITE.technical_action: After-hours: beat views and guided above Q3 expectations. High ATR (~11%).
LITE.story: Optical networking. Post-earnings reaction will be key; likely a big mover tomorrow.

SMCI.technical_action: Popping after-hours on positive earnings. Still plagued by legal/accounting issues; wide and loose action.
SMCI.story: AI server/competitor to Dell and HPE. Not institutional quality.

CRWV.technical_action: Up 8-10% after-hours on earnings. Lagging NeoCloud play with overhead resistance.
CRWV.story: AI cloud/NeoCloud. A pop, but needs a base to become actionable; better names exist in the group.
